name: hy3d_storage_box_virtual_hinge
description: White plastic storage box with a hinged lid. Mesh generated by Hunyuan3D-2 (Hugging Face Space, shape only, seed 5763854) from a FLUX.1-schnell reference image (samples/hy3d/box_ref_ai.png); the lid is modelled in the open position. FIX-UP VARIANT: same mesh, joint moved to the best-fit virtual pivot found by calibrate_pivot and the opening travel reduced.
dimension_basis: prompt asked for 40 x 30 x 27 cm; width is the scale basis because the lid is modelled open (overall height is not the body height). At 40 cm width the model's own proportions give depth 0.298 m and body (rim) height 0.218 m, i.e. the generator made the box 5 cm shorter than asked.
density_basis: polypropylene, assumed uniform; walls are thin shells, filled holes may over-estimate mass

split.basis: measured: the highest slice that still spans the full depth (the rim) is at z = 0.218 m; cut 3 mm above it so the rim stays with the body

joints.name: lid_hinge
joints.basis: calibrate_pivot: the modelled knuckle position (0, 0.142, 0.218) cannot close the lid for any pivot within +-3 cm; a pivot 3 cm inside and 6 cm above the rim brings the sweep under 3 mm with travel -20..68 deg. This is a VIRTUAL hinge that only exists for simulation: the generated lid is too thick/long for a hinge on its own back edge. 0 = as modelled, +68 = closed, -20 = opened further
